runtimeFindings.impact: Stream abort advances origin past unfinished ordinary transaction; disabling and re-enabling apply permanently skips its committed publisher row.
Stream replay during dependency-memory suspension loses an UPDATE; publisher v2, subscriber v1.
Subscriber STABLE default uses pre-wait snapshot; count 0 instead of 1.
Unchanged external TOAST FK outside replica identity triggers apply-leader assertion.
Numerically equal differently encoded keys miss dependency; UPDATE 1.0 to 2 then INSERT 1.00 causes subscriber unique conflict.
Child-side replica-enabled FK triggers miss parent insertion dependency when parent triggers remain origin-only.
Later UPDATE overtakes an earlier trigger's unpublished INSERT; publisher value 2, subscriber value 1, with identical schemas.

finalHarnessRun.outcome: Seven defects reproduced, four serial controls correct, one partition corruption probe not reproduced.

refutationProbes.details: TRUNCATE, INSERT, UPDATE through reordered leaf gives correct 99|v|m. This rejects that concrete persistent-map-corruption schedule, not separate dropped-column/OOB hypotheses.

limitations: PASS in bug-reproduction tests means the defect was observed, not fixed. All other reviewer hypotheses remain unconfirmed unless separately adjudicated. Assertion-enabled build; no non-assert build validation. No product code changed.
